scenes.audio: A loud sound effect of the racket hitting the ball is heard, followed by a cheering crowd.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A tennis match is shown from a high camera angle at an indoor arena. A man around 30 years old with fair skin and dark hair is on the court wearing a maroon polo shirt and white shorts. A second man around 25 years old with light skin and dark hair is at the opposite end of the court, wearing a blue shirt and black shorts. The first man hits the tennis ball with his racket.

scenes.audio: Repetitive sounds of tennis rackets hitting the ball occur with each volley.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The two men continue to hit the ball back and forth across the net. The camera remains in a static wide shot of the court. The lighting is bright and overhead, creating distinct shadows on the blue court surface.

scenes.audio: Squeaking sounds of shoes on the court surface and more hits of the ball.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The volley continues as both players move quickly around their respective sides of the court. The second player in the blue shirt moves forward toward the net to return a shot.

scenes.audio: The crowd begins to cheer and clap as the point concludes.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The rally becomes more intense as the players trade deep shots from the back of the court. Finally, the player in blue hits a shot that the player in maroon cannot reach, ending the point.

scenes.audio: A commentator says, 'Oh! That line again! Couple of outrageous forehands up the line from Daniil Medvedev.'
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A close-up of the man in the maroon shirt. He has a serious expression and is looking toward the other side of the court. He is sweating slightly.

scenes.audio: Crowd noise continues with applause and shouting.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A shot of the crowd in the arena. They are sitting in blue seats and many are clapping and cheering. The man in the blue shirt is then shown briefly from the back as he walks away from the net.

scenes.audio: Commentator says: 'This time, the pressure does tell, it's been coming!'
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Back to the wide shot of the court for another point. The players exchange several shots. The player in the maroon shirt hits a particularly powerful backhand.

scenes.audio: Commentator: 'A ridiculous opening set of tennis!' followed by loud crowd cheering.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The final point shown is a long rally. Both players are using a variety of shots including slices and volleys. The man in the blue shirt eventually wins the point after his opponent hits the ball into the net.
